protocol.demoted_metric: mean censored cost / v1 mean-gain (continuity only, no decision role)
protocol.analysis: unpaired across arms (weighted rng consumes the RNG stream differently; pairing is nominal — documented v1 weakness)
protocol.statistics: two-sided Fisher exact on pooled 2x2, alpha=0.05

rules_registered: R1: promising/harmful iff Fisher p<0.05 AND sign-consistent in >=3/4 scenarios
R2: if prior_s00 (pure reshuffle) is detectable, bias verdicts are drawn vs prior_s00
R3: 'promising' only registers a follow-up tuning experiment; default stays off
